rationale: Voltage drops below the 0.9 pu sag threshold from 40 ms through 100 ms (0.86, 0.62, 0.58, 0.74 pu), staying above the 0.1 pu interruption threshold, so the contiguous non-normal interval is classified as a voltage sag. It returns to normal (0.91 pu) at 120 ms. Duration counts the 4 samples in the interval inclusive of one sample period: 4 x 20 ms = 80 ms = 0.08 s. Minimum voltage 0.58 pu and maximum current 1.44 pu occur at 80 ms.
